title: a box's boot reads the pid map without an error in the database's log
note: basis 'shown' means shown by the card's unit test, which runs both readers' query with the real psql against a database with no pidmap schema, failing on the base and passing with the change.

findings.claim: the host check read pidmap.site_key with no guard in check_host.sh and in doctor_image.pidmap_row, so before the first night each boot logged relation pidmap.site_key does not exist twice and the doctor got 'unread' instead of 'no row'
the two readers carried the pid map's query as two copies of one text; they are now one text held equal by a test
